:::{#def-indexed-union}
#### Union of a family of sets

Let $I$ be a set of indices,
such as $\cb{1, \ldots, n}$ or $\cb{1, 2, 3, \ldots}$,
and let $A_i$ be a set for each $i \in I$.
The **union** of the sets $A_i$,
written $\bigcup_{i \in I} A_i$,
is the set of elements that are in at least one $A_i$.
For $I = \cb{1, \ldots, n}$, it is also written $\bigcup_{i=1}^{n} A_i$ or $A_1 \cup \cdots \cup A_n$,
and for $I = \cb{1, 2, 3, \ldots}$, it is written $\bigcup_{i=1}^{\infty} A_i$.

:::
